property.name: suiteName
property.value: Billing Contract to Contract - Bill both contracts US139232

testcase.name: Prereq Should create and set the value BILLING C2C BILLING CONTRACT PRIO in SYSTEM CONFIGS in Data Explorer to NULL with API
Prereq Should create a new yard if not already created
Prereq Should create a new partner if not already created
Prereq Should create a new site if not already created
To avoid holidays test cases Create a new blank calendar
Should create a new resource of type equipment which starts to be available from 15 days ago
Should create a pricing procedure time based for our resource being valid from 15 days ago
Should manage conditions time based being valid from 15 days ago
Should do a stock increase handover with custom quantity being received 15 days ago
